chunks: 3212 - It is narrated from ʿAlī ibn Ḥassān, who said:
Al-Riḍā عليه السلام was asked about going to the grave of Abī al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام, and he said:

"Pray in the mosques around it, and it suffices in all places that you say: Peace be upon the awliyāʾ of Allah and His chosen ones. Peace be upon the trustees of Allah and His beloved ones. Peace be upon the helpers of Allah and His successors. Peace be upon the loci of the maʿrifah of Allah. Peace be upon the dwellings of the dhikr of Allah. Peace be upon those who manifest the command of Allah and His prohibition. Peace be upon the callers to Allah. Peace be upon those firmly established in the pleasure of Allah. Peace be upon those made sincere in obedience to Allah. Peace be upon the guides to Allah. Peace be upon those such that whoever befriends them has befriended Allah, and whoever opposes them has opposed Allah; and whoever knows them has known Allah, and whoever is ignorant of them has been ignorant of Allah; and whoever holds fast to them has held fast to Allah, and whoever abandons them has abandoned Allah, Mighty and Majestic. And I call Allah to witness that I am at peace with those with whom you are at peace and at war with those with whom you are at war, believing in your secret and your openness, consigning all of that to you. May Allah curse the enemy of the family of Muḥammad from among the jinn and humankind, and I disavow myself before Allah from them. And may Allah bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad."

[And] this suffices in all the ziyārāt, and you should abundantly invoke blessings upon Muḥammad and his family, the Imams, naming them one by one by their names, disavow yourself from their enemies, and choose whatever supplication you wish for yourself and for the believing men and the believing women.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءِ: the awliyāʾ, those vested with divine closeness and authority
key_terms.اعْتَصَمَ: held fast firmly, sought refuge through adherence
key_terms.الزِّيَارَاتِ: acts of visitation to sacred graves or shrines
key_terms.الْمُخْلَصِينَ: those made sincere and purified in devotion
key_terms.سِلْمٌ: being at peace and in accord

ai.seo_question: What should be recited when visiting the graves of the Imams in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a concise form of ziyārah for visiting the grave of Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام and states that it is sufficient for all ziyārāt. It emphasizes salām upon the awliyāʾ of Allah, loyalty to them, dissociation from their enemies, and abundant salawat upon Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his family.
